question: What Pd and Cu contents did XPS give for the (Pd/Cu)1%TiO2 photocatalyst in the photocatalytic ozonation study?
rendered:
According to Table 1, the XPS analysis of the (Pd/Cu)1%TiO2 photocatalyst showed the following contents: 

Pd: 17.15 at.%
Cu: 25.31 at.%
Pd:Cu atomic ratio: 0.68
